newsitem.title: USA: Graphic says its chairman named president.
newsitem.headline: Graphic says its chairman named president.

text.p: Graphic Industries Inc said on Friday that its chairman and chief executive officer, Mark Pope III, would also assume his son's job as company president because Mark Pope IV was leaving to pursue other interests.

Pope IV was elected president of Graphic in 1989 and had been a member of the board of directors since 1978. He is leaving to pursue other business interests in a non-related industry, Graphic said in a statement.
His father founded Graphic in 1970 and the company went public in 1983.
"We greatly appreciate all the contributions that Mark has made to the growth and success of Graphic during his years of service to the Company," Mark Pope III said in a statement.
Graphic provides printing and graphic communication services for major U.S. markets.
